title: the RITMO cards
blocker: and the SALA AHORA panel could blink with the BPM the desk already knows, so the room's beat is visible at a glance (`docs/design/v3/ritmo.png`, "nuevo" dot; rejected for v3 in `docs/design/v3/gaps.md`). The desk has no clock locked to QLC+'s tempo, so a free-running blink drifts from the show. Read on 2026-11-02 in `~/p/qlcplus` (`webaccess/src/webaccess-qml.cpp`, 531276f0): the web socket sends no beat and no tempo phase. A speed dial reports `<id>|SPEED_STATE|<time>|<factor>` only when its time or factor changes, and `MasterTimer::beat` reaches no web socket message. One phase source does exist: a cue list sends `<id>|CUE|<index>` on every step, so a hidden cue list running a beat-tempo chaser of empty steps, generated by qlctool, would tick on QLC+'s own beat. That changes the generated show and the desk. Blocked: the owner decides between that cue-list beat and dropping the pulse.
